derivation: from G473 (ἀντί) and the middle voice of G3670 (ὁμολογέω);
def: to confess in turn, i.e. respond in praise

occurrences.text: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
